name: Aries
personality: Brave, confident, energetic, passionate, and adventurous.
description: Aries are energetic and courageous people who enjoy taking action, leading others, and exploring new challenges.

name: Taurus
personality: Reliable, patient, practical, loyal, and calm.
description: Taurus are dependable people who appreciate comfort, stability, beauty, and the simple things in life.

name: Gemini
personality: Curious, social, adaptable, intelligent, and communicative.
description: Gemini are curious and social people who enjoy learning, communicating, and exploring different ideas.

name: Cancer
personality: Caring, emotional, loyal, protective, and sensitive.
description: Cancer are caring people who value family, friendship, emotional connection, and a comfortable home.

name: Leo
personality: Confident, generous, creative, passionate, and charismatic.
description: Leo are confident and expressive people who enjoy creativity, leadership, attention, and making others happy.

name: Virgo
personality: Organized, intelligent, practical, careful, and hardworking.
description: Virgo are thoughtful and organized people who enjoy helping others, solving problems, and improving their surroundings.

name: Libra
personality: Friendly, diplomatic, charming, peaceful, and social.
description: Libra are social and peaceful people who value balance, fairness, beauty, and good relationships.

name: Scorpio
personality: Passionate, mysterious, loyal, determined, and brave.
description: Scorpio are passionate and determined people who value trust, loyalty, deep connections, and personal strength.

name: Sagittarius
personality: Adventurous, optimistic, honest, independent, and energetic.
description: Sagittarius are adventurous people who enjoy traveling, learning, discovering new experiences, and being independent.

name: Capricorn
personality: Responsible, disciplined, ambitious, patient, and practical.
description: Capricorn are hardworking and responsible people who value success, discipline, stability, and long-term goals.

name: Aquarius
personality: Independent, creative, intelligent, original, and humanitarian.
description: Aquarius are independent thinkers who enjoy new ideas, creativity, technology, and helping others.

name: Pisces
personality: Compassionate, imaginative, gentle, emotional, and artistic.
description: Pisces are imaginative and compassionate people who enjoy creativity, helping others, and expressing their emotions.
